artifact: Issue #9 M4-1 current contract gap map
work_item_name: M4-1 Mutation Intent / Operation Descriptor / Canonical Mutation Result Contract Freeze

entries.current_capability: Serializable descriptor with deterministic canonical JSON and SHA-256 contract_hash; declarative read/write, mutation scope, authority, approval, predecessor/successor, idempotency and error fields already exist.
entries.current_limitation: Mutation fields are declarations only; no write operation is exposed or enforced by the current ingress.
m4_1_required_semantics: freeze semantic input and trusted context namespaces
freeze result/error contract reference
freeze hash inclusion and exclusion rules

entries.current_capability: One process-local registry stores descriptors separately from optional callable bindings, rejects duplicate names, and lists descriptors deterministically.
entries.current_limitation: A binding is not durable dispatch, authority, lease issuance, or production mutation activation.
m4_1_required_semantics: retain one registry for read and write descriptors
keep callable identity outside contract semantics

entries.current_capability: Canonical operation lookup, input validation, trusted-context resolution, handler normalization, correlation and machine result envelope exist for read-only operations.
entries.current_limitation: The integrated path rejects every descriptor whose classification is not read-only; it is not write-capable at this checkpoint.
m4_1_required_semantics: define the result contract consumed by future write ingress
do not change ingress in M4-1

entries.current_capability: OperationContext carries operation identity, correlation, typed principal, semantic inputs, trusted metadata and contract_hash; TrustedContext is a private-boundary carrier.
entries.current_limitation: Reserved subject, revision, authority and capability_lease fields are None placeholders; ContextResolver cannot select subjects, mint authority or leases, or make lifecycle decisions.
m4_1_required_semantics: separate model-facing intent from trusted mechanical binding
preserve trusted adapter boundary
bind typed target and preconditions only after intent

entries.current_capability: General envelope emits status, result, errors, blockers, semantic_choices, next_action and correlation_id alongside stable ok/data/evidence/warnings fields.
entries.current_limitation: There is no canonical mutation_effect or authoritative_effect_confirmed field, so external materialization outcome cannot yet be represented.
m4_1_required_semantics: separate operation status from mutation effect
make unknown authoritative outcome non-success
preserve distinct choice, conflict, blocked and no-effect meanings

entries.current_capability: Bounded machine-readable ForgeError codes serialize and round-trip; distinct semantic errors such as NEEDS_SEMANTIC_CHOICE are available.
entries.current_limitation: Mutation-specific effect and external materialization error mapping is not frozen as one descriptor/result contract.
m4_1_required_semantics: machine-readable mutation error codes
choice/error separation
mapping of effect state to envelope without generic error collapse

entries.current_capability: Deterministic canonical_fingerprint supports same-key replay and same-key/different-fingerprint conflict in the isolated transaction foundation.
entries.current_limitation: IdempotencyStore is isolated and test-scoped; mutation intent fingerprint semantics are not yet a standalone Core contract.
m4_1_required_semantics: bind idempotency identity to exact semantic intent
exclude runtime and credential values
define replay-compatible versus conflict

entries.current_capability: AuthorityEngine evaluates trusted principal, typed target, scope, revision, approval and Decision evidence without semantic selection or graph writes.
entries.current_limitation: It evaluates supplied facts only; M4-1 does not issue authorization or decide whether a request is permitted.
m4_1_required_semantics: descriptor declares required authority and approval/Decision requirements
intent carries authorization evidence only after trusted resolution

entries.current_capability: Bounded executor-neutral lease schema validates operation, typed target, scope, expiry, expected revision and contract_hash; authority evaluation checks bindings.
entries.current_limitation: Fixture revoke/consume copies are not durable or atomic, and no issuer protocol exists in this work item.
m4_1_required_semantics: allow a lease or reservation reference as trusted evidence
never make a model-provided lease authoritative
defer issuance to M4-2

entries.current_capability: Subject expected revision and isolated transaction CAS reject stale updates; idempotent committed replay reuses the prior result.
entries.current_limitation: The source primitive is isolated/non-authoritative, and external authority raw revision/digest is a separate domain not represented by ingress.
m4_1_required_semantics: name subject_expected_revision separately from authority_source_revision
permit trusted binding of both domains without conflation

entries.current_capability: PortablePlanDocument and normalized digest are read-side, platform-neutral observations; Issue body remains Plan authority and historical sections remain provenance.
entries.current_limitation: No write port, lifecycle mutation, raw precondition or authoritative materialization exists.
m4_1_required_semantics: use normalized_plan_digest as semantic identity only
do not use it as external CAS
keep write adapter out of M4-1

entries.current_capability: PlanAuthorityReadAdapter returns body, opaque source revision/digest and control projections without exposing platform identifiers to Core.
entries.current_limitation: It is read-only; no mutation port, raw precondition, journal or write verification exists.
m4_1_required_semantics: define opaque authority precondition fields for later M4-5/M4-6 consumption
remain platform-neutral

entries.current_capability: CLI argument schema is derived from the canonical descriptor and includes protocol_version and contract_hash.
entries.current_limitation: Only read operations are wired; no mutation command or numeric projection for mutation effects exists.
m4_1_required_semantics: project the frozen descriptor/result without adding CLI semantics
defer mutation CLI wiring to M4-8

entries.current_capability: Hermes request schema is derived from the descriptor, separates arguments from trusted metadata, and checks expected protocol/hash identity.
entries.current_limitation: Schema compatibility is the only relevant capability; Hermes runtime mutation activation and executor lifecycle are M5 concerns.
m4_1_required_semantics: project semantic inputs only in arguments
carry trusted metadata only through trusted boundary
defer runtime dispatch
